notes: The admin app's bundle budget (ADR-0052 §The bundle budget, D10.5).
Bytes are GZIPPED, which is what a browser downloads; `pnpm size` measures dist/ and fails the gate when a number here is exceeded.
js = every JavaScript byte the build emits. css = every CSS byte. entry = dist/assets/index-<hash>.js, the chunk paid before anything renders.
Raising a budget is a deliberate diff of this file that someone reviews — that is the whole mechanism. Lowering one after a real saving is just as welcome.
The headroom over the baseline is about 8% (11% on css, where a percentage of 14 kB is noise): enough for honest growth, tight enough that a new dependency trips it.

Baseline first measured 2026-08-29 at D10.5, on the tree that already carried D10.3's @dnd-kit and D10.4's stylesheet fix — the first build in which @repo/grid's and @repo/form's utilities actually reach the CSS. Re-measured 2026-08-30 at D11.1; the js and entry numbers moved by 47 and 2 bytes, which is what 'a token re-skin ships no code' looks like from here.

css rose 12598 -> 14042 at D11.1 and its budget with it, deliberately: ADR-0054 §1 self-hosts IBM Plex through @fontsource, and five @fontsource stylesheets (Sans 400/500/600, Mono 400/500, whole faces so unicode-range can do the choosing) carry 28 @font-face rules - ~12.4 kB of very repetitive CSS that gzips to ~1.4 kB. The woff2/woff files themselves are emitted assets and are NOT counted here — a browser downloads only the subsets its text needs, so what this number prices is the declaration, not the faces.

entry is resolved from dist/index.html rather than matched by filename: at D10.5's review an index-*.js pattern was found to match two chunks (the real entry plus an unrelated 0.6 kB one), and it would match zero the day Vite's entryFileNames changes - which would pass green forever.

NOT RAISED at D14.8, which is the outcome ADR-0062 §1 predicted: the composition moved into @repo/app-kit and the same code is still shipped, so `pnpm size` prints js 334.2 / css 14.5 / entry 255.4 kB against 353.5 / 15.2 / 273.4. The one real addition is the top-level error boundary and its crash surface, which is a class component, a paragraph and a button — the ~0.6 kB the entry moved. The next raise this file expects is D14.9's, and it will be a *shape* change rather than a number: per-chunk ceilings beside these totals (ADR-0062 §4).
